scheme_name: Scheme for Grant of Additional Scholarship to the Students of Other Backward Classes of Andaman and Nicobar Islands, for Pursuing Higher Studies Anywhere in India after Secondary Level (Except Class XI & XII)
other_conditions: Must belong to the non‑creamy layer of OBC as listed in the notification dated 16‑12‑2005
Must be a domicile of Andaman and Nicobar Islands
Must have passed Secondary (Class X) or Senior Secondary (Class XII) from a recognized board of school education
Must be pursuing higher education in a recognized institution/university on a regular/full‑time basis
Only two children of the same parent/guardian are eligible for the scholarship (if more than one child from a second live birth, all are eligible)
Scholarship is subject to good conduct and regular attendance certified by the Head of the Institution
Students pursuing postgraduate courses in Medicine must not be allowed to practice during the course
Renewal is on a year‑to‑year basis and requires promotion to the next class, with a medical certificate if unable to appear for exams due to illness
benefits_summary: A scholarship of ₹1000 per month, payable for ten months of each academic session.
